title: Penske Media and Chegg appeal dismissal of AI Overviews lawsuit against Google
content:
X author: @pressgazette

Penske Media and Chegg filed an appeal after a court dismissed their lawsuit against Google alleging AI Overviews harmed their traffic and revenue, citing no formal bargain with Google.
